name: Image rotozoomer
description: The 1990 rotozoomer, over one of the project's own images instead of a generated tile. Mirrored at the tile edges so a photograph repeats without a seam, zoom snapping on the beat.

tiles.description: How many copies of the picture across the frame. A photograph wants barely more than one - past about 3 it stops being a picture of anything and becomes wallpaper.

tone.description: How far the picture is pulled into the run's palette.
